description: Shorti(쇼티) for «check my take» or «내가 찍은 거 봐줘». A link where the person checks their own take against a format's hits, and what they send back. `format` (a format_id): a link to open on their phone and upload; you never see the video. Then call with `token` alone until `shared`: their summary, its cue check first. Call it feedback (피드백); a likeness is not a forecast of views.

recipe_ref.description: The recipe_ref a recipe tool returned, so the take the person checks is tied to it.

token.description: The token a previous call gave.

name: shorti_check_link
title: Check a take
